title: Nteasee: Understanding Needs in AI for Health in Africa - A Mixed-Methods Study of Expert and General Population Perspectives
reasoning: The study includes a specific evaluation of how AI handles religious and ethical contexts in the African healthcare landscape. It features case studies that explicitly ask participants to evaluate LLM chatbot responses regarding spiritual guidance, religious leaders (e.g., imams), and religious identity (e.g., a Muslim woman seeking advice), as well as dedicated thematic sections on ethical considerations and values.
